sentences.text: Jintasaurus is a genus of hadrosauriform dinosaur known as the "Jinta County dragon".
The only known specimen is a partial postorbital skull that lacks the jugal and quadratojugal bones.
Its skull features an extremely long paraoccipital process projecting over the lower part of the occipital condyle.
The type species Jintasaurus meniscus was described by Hai-Lu You and Da-Qing Li in 2009.
Jintasaurus was likely a relatively robust, semi-bipedal herbivore about six meters long.
Jintasaurus is classified within the infraorder Iguanodontia.
Jintasaurus lived during the Early Cretaceous in what is now Jiuquan, Gansu, in northwestern China.
It lived during the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 105 million years ago in the Albian stage.
The time range for Jintasaurus is estimated from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
